==English==

===Etymology===
From {{uder|en|fr|réprimande}}, from {{m|fr|réprimer||to repress}}.

===Pronunciation===

** {{IPA|en|/ˈɹɛpɹɪmɑːnd/|a=noun}}

** {{rhymes|en|ænd|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A severe, formal or official [[reproof]]; [[reprehension]], [[rebuke]], private or public.
#* {{RQ:Macaulay Goldsmith|passage=Goldsmith gave his landlady a sharp '''reprimand''' for her treatment of him.}}
